theory.note: centre_energy: kinetic energy at the centre for an ion starting at rest on the wall, ignoring the other ions; bounce radius: where a smooth thin shell of the same charge would stop (space-charge limit), mean charge 2.02

wall_spectrum.note: kinetic energy of ions when they come back out through the cavity wall

energy.note: field_energy_min: electrostatic energy of the hot-electron cloud with its compensating positive charge right at the wall, k Q_e^2 / (10 R); the laser must supply at least this
